podcast.body: This was Blind Melon's second album, which the band managed to get through recording. Its completion was followed by the initiation of a projected 18-month tour on September 19, 1995. "The band did manage to get through the recording of their second album, which they called Soup."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
